input.comment: [Playbook] We cannot restrict our business or internal development activities, so we have deleted the 24-month, all-product, worldwide non-compete in Section 12.4, which also contradicts Section 12.3's express acknowledgement that we have made no non-compete commitment. If you need protection for the relationship, we could discuss a narrow restriction limited to a named competing product, during the term only and capped at 12 months, with carve-outs for our internal development and acquisitions.
input.summary: Delete the non-compete imposed on Customer in Section 12.4.
